Volume Rendering - Lei Mao's Log Book
Introduction Volume rendering is a technique used to display a 2D projection of a 3D scalar field. It's widely used for 3D data visualization, such as medical imaging. In this blog post, we will discuss mathematically the basic optical model for volume rendering and how to estimate the observed color of a ray casting on the 2D image.
